text: A psalm. Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
and revealed his righteousness to the nations.
and his faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
burst into jubilant song with music;
with the harp and the sound of singing,
shout for joy before the Lord, the King.
the world, and all who live in it.
let the mountains sing together for joy;
for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.
